tei:div.tei:p: "$ (423)༄༅// bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud bsdus pa ngam rdzong lugs kyi sgrub dkyil dbang chog dang bcas pa he ru ka dgyes pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(424)༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra samba rā ya/ bde stong 'khor lor chos kun sdom// bla ma he ru ka dpal gyi// zhabs pad spyi bor bkod nas 'dir// snyan brgyud bsdus pa'i lag len dgod// ngam rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza'i lugs kyi bde mchog snyan brgyud lag len du bstar ba la lnga/ bdag bskyed sgrub thabs/ sta gon gyi rim pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos dben pa'i gnas su 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs rten bkram pa'i spyan sngar phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod bdud rtsi/ mchod gtor/ sngon 'gro/ dkar bgegs/ rang gi mdun du ḍār dril sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ thog mar dag pa gsum dran pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur/ a ā i ī sogs dbyangs gsal tshar gcig brjod/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni spros dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa// a haṃ bde ba chen po'o// rdor dril byin rlabs ni/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra āḥ.oṃ sarba ta (425)thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ko3haṃ/ sngon gtor dkar bgegs bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zad mi shes par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams dang bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron thams cad bkug par gyur/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngo/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid yul 'di'i gzhi yis bdag pos gtso byas pa'i lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag gi bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig

/nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyang gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /sumbha ni'i sngags drag tu brjod la rol mo bcas bskrad do// nang mchod byin brlab ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la brten pa'i a yig las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya (426)che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bo kha ṭwāṃ ga rnams 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus bskol zhing zhu ba las dam tshig pa dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ gong ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi nang thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ ma hā badzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda 'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag gzhan mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la=chos la= dge 'dun la= dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan grangs ci nus brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o//

lan gsum brjod do// bsags sbyong gsal 'debs rnams ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa la yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ hūm̐ las rdo rje bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin thabs dang*/ a las dril bu stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i rang bzhin shes rab tu gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma he ru ka'i rnam par snang ba spyi (427)bor spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis phyag bya/ oṃ he ru ka ārghaṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thog mtha' des 'gres te/ puṣpe nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun tshogs shing*// dri med snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu yi// lam mchog mngon du mdzad nas ston mdzad pa'i// bde mchog rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ badzra he ru ka'i yig brgya bzla/ phyi yi maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas mdzes// nang gi maṇḍal rtsa 'khor byang sems yi ge'i rnam par bde ba'i mdangs dang ldan// gsang ba'i maṇḍal tshad med dga' bzhi bde chen 'gyur med byang chub sems kyis brgyan// de nyid maṇḍal bde stong rol ba 'bul lo mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī he ru ka ārghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ pañtsa a mṛ ta dang*/ badzra ma tiṅga sbyar bas nang gsang 'bul/ yan lag lhag ma rnams dang dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgyid cing*// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las// grol bar bdag gis bsgrub par bgyid// bstan sogs dge ba de dag gi

/rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i// sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas// 'gro ba yongs su sgrol byed shog / lan gsum/ he ru ka yi gnas gsum gsang hoḥlas// 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser babs shing thim// dbang bzhis rgyud smin sgrib bzhi dag pa dang*// lam bzhi mthar phyin sku bzhi thob par shog /bde mchog rang la thim pas spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ (428 )lan gsum/ de rnams kyis sngon 'gro song*/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar tshad med dang srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ shrī he ru ka /rang gi thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po la oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ bde ba dang ldan pa dang*/ bde ba yun ring gnas pa dang*/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'od zer nag po hūm̐ gi rnam par 'phros pas/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs su rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po/ steng du rdo rje'i gur dang bla brel gyur/ rdo rje de dag las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las khro mo brgyad du gyur te/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas g.yon du bskor bas sprul pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bgegs rnams phye mar brlags te me'i ra bar gyur/ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i ngang du gnas par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro bar gyur/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gi dbus su pam̐ las padma/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/

de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ nag po la ā li dkar po g.yon skor dang kā li dmar po g.yas skor yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ phyogs bzhir hūm̐ bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shrī he ru ka khrag 'thung dpal// skad cig gis ni sku rdzogs pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// dus mtshan dang ni 'jigs byed dag /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis mnan mdzad pa// bai ḍūr nam mkha'i rang bzhin can// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa mchog /sna tshogs rdo rje phyag rgya drug /zla phyed mgo phreng dag gis brgyan// sgeg (429)sogs gar gyi ro ldan pa// stag lpags dar gyi cod pan can// yid bzhin nor bu spyi bor 'dzin// rdo rje phag mo sku la 'khril// dzwa wa sindhū ra mdog mtshungs// thod pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad// gcer bu bcu drug na tshod can// rus pa'i 'khor lo mgo phreng dang*// cod pan dum bu'i rgyan gyis spras// skra grol ba la spyan gsum pa// bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid do// shar du he ru ka dkar po// 'khor lo dril bsnams mkha' 'gror 'khyud// byang du he ru ka ljang gu// rgya gram dril bsnams lā mar 'khyud// nub tu he ru ka dmar po// padma dril bsnams dum skyes 'khyud// lho ru he ru ka ser po// rin chen dril bsnams gzugs mar 'khyud// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan gsum dar gyi cod pan can// 'jigs byed dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan// phyag rgya drug gis spras pa'o// mtshams kyi padma'i 'dab ma la// byang sems gang ba'i thod pa bzhi// gzugs phung spyi bor rnam snang mdzad// tshor phung dpral bar rdor nyi ma// 'du shes mgrin par pad gar dbang*// 'du byed lte bar rdor rgyal po// rnam shes rdo rjer rdo rje sems// thugs kar kun 'dus he ru ka /mig gnyis la ni sa yi snying*// rna ba gnyis la phyag na rdor// sna la nam mkha'i snying po dang*// kha ru spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug

/rdo rjer sgrib pa rnam par sel// snying gar rdo rje sems dpa'o// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams// rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs ma bkod/ rkang pa gnyis yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ sum mdo ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa ram̐ dmar nag gis mtshan pa/ lte bar bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sgal tshigs bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i ri rab (430)de'i steng du sna tshogs padma'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma la/ hūm̐ dang dbyangs gsal yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo lnga'i rnam par snang bar gyur// bcom ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo ni// zhal bzhi pa la phyag bcu gnyis// gsum gsum spyan mnga' 'gyur ba'i zhal// nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs 'od 'phro ba// dus mtshan dmar ba g.yas brkyang dang*// g.yon zhabs 'jigs byed nag po mnan// rtsa ba'i zhal ni sku dang mthun// g.yas pa gser gyi mdog dang mtshungs// rgyab zhal padma rā ga'i mdog /ind+ra nī la'i zhal g.yon no// rdo rje dril bu dang po ste// gnyis pas glang po'i pags pa bsnams// ḍā ma ru dang dgra st+wa dang*// gri gug mdung rtse gsum pa ni// g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa'o// kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod khrag dang*// rdo rje'i zhags pa tshangs mgo ste// g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams pa'o// sgeg sogs gar nyams kun tu bsgyur// stag lpags sham thabs mgo phreng can// phyag rgya drug gis spras pa'i sku// thor tshugs dar gyi cod pan can// zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// yid bzhin nor bu dbu la 'jog /rus pa'i 'khor los spyi bor mtshan// yang dag 'khyud pa'i phag mo yang*// bde ster rang bzhin sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gcer bu'i tshul// byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khyud// rdo rje thod pa bsnams pa ste// steng phyogs la rdeg skra grol ma// phyag rgya lngas spras yab la dgyes// bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid do// phyogs kyi padma'i 'dab bzhi la// shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga

/byang du lā ma mdog ljang gu// nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma// g.yas pa gnyis na ḍā ma ru gri gug /g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams// skra grol gcer (431)mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa// mtshams bzhir byang sems gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ ༈ thugs kyi 'khor lo mthing nag rdor phreng bskor// mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo sku mdog mthing*// zhal gcig spyan gsum pa dang phyag bzhi yi// dang pos rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud// 'og gnyis ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga/dpa' mo rdo rje thod pa bsnams pa ste// kun gyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan// mgo la thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma// spyi gtsug keng rus chen po gtum mig ma// rna g.yas ka pa la dang 'od ldan ma// ltag khungs mche gtsigs sna chen dpa' mo'o// rna g.yon lha dgra dpa' bo blo chen ma// smin dbus 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma// mig tu rdo rje'i 'od dang lang dbang phyug /phrag par rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ ༈ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad phreng bskor// sa la spyod dmar dang pos pad dril 'khyud// mchan khungs myu gu can dang sa srung ma// nu mar rdo rje ral can 'jigs byed ma// lte bar dpa' chen rlung gi shugs can ma// sna rtser rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma// kha ru rab bzang lha mo sngo bsangs ma// mgrin par rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang ma// snying gar 'jigs byed che dang rta rna ma// 'doms su mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma/ ༈ sku yi 'khor lo dkar po 'khor phreng bskor// sa 'og spyod dkar dang pos 'khor dril 'khyud// mtshan mar stobs po che dang 'khor shugs can// bshang sgor rin chen rdo rje dum skyes ma// brla gnyis la ni rta mgrin chang tshong ma// byin par nam mkha'i snying po go cha ma// sor mor he ru ka dang rab dpa' mo// rkang bol padma gar dbang stobs chen ma// mthe bong rnam snang 'khor los sgyur ba ma// pus mor rdor sems brtson 'grus chen mo'o// shar sgor kha la khwa gdong ma nag mo// byang sgo sna la 'ug gdong ma ljang gu// nub sgo mchan rtser khyi gdong ma dmar mo// (432)lho sgo bshang lam phag gdong ma ser mo// shar lho rna g.yas gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/

lho nub rna g.yon gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang mig g.yas gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar mig g.yon gshin rje 'jom pa ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug dang*/ g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ gsal la rnyog pa med pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ka ya wā ka tsitta badzra swā bhā wa ko3haṃ/ kun rdzob tu snang ba'i cha ma spangs pa la/ stong pa'i cha ma dor ba'i snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i lha so bdun/ byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun dang*/ sa bcu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor gyur/ he ru ka lha lnga'i thugs kar oṃ haḥlas rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ spyi bor na ma hi las rnam snang ser po g.yas 'khor lo/ ltag par swā hā hu las padma gar dbang dmar po g.yas padma/ phrag par bau ṣaṭa he las badzra he ru ka mthing ga g.yas rdo rje/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser g.yas rin po che/ dpral bar phaṭa phaṭa ham̐ las rta mchog ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ las phag mo dmar mo// snying gar ham̐ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hreṃ hrī las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ dpral bar phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dud ka /thams cad kyang g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin cing gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las (433)'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha mo 'phros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes spyi bo nas bde ba chen po rgyas byed byang sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i bum chus dbang bzhi bskur bas/ dbang gi chus lus gang*/ sdig sgrib dag par byas/ chu lhag mas gtso mo la mi bskyod pa/ lha gzhan la rigs so sos dbur brgyan par gyur te/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa de dag gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐/

des 'gres te/ puṣpe nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ phul byung gzugs mdzes yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spung*// lang tsho rab rgyas glu dang gar la mkhas// dbang po drug la rmad byung bde ba ster// kun gyi dga' skyed mchod pa'i lha mo ni// pi wang gling bu mṛ taṅga rdza rnga// bzhad dang snyems dang ting 'khrol gar sgyur ma// me tog bdug spos mar me dri zhim dang*// me long ro mchog gos bzang chos 'byung mas// rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyis legs mchod na// dgyes bzhin bzhes te mchog rnams stsal du gsol/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// dbu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra st+wa zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung rtse bsnams// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud ka bgegs 'dul mdzad la 'dud/ oṃ/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs kun rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje'i gdan (434)bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs kun skem zhing pham mdzad ma// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces yab yum rkang brgyad dang*/ bsdu na/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

/he ru ka lha lnga so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang rang gi sa bon la sngags phreng gis g.yon du bskor ba las/ rang rang gi mdog can gyi 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad bde mchog la bgod cing char thim par bsams la/ gtso bo zhal sbyor gyi bzlas pa dang*/ gzhan rnams phan tshun drwa bas 'brel ba'i tshul gyis bzla/ yab kyi snying po ni/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi nye snying ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye snying ni/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ he ru ka bzhi'i snying po ni/ oṃ shrī buddha he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī karma= oṃ shrī padma= oṃ shrī ratna= rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i snying po ni/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ riṃ rīṃ liṃ līṃ kaṃ nas saṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ thun mthar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum kyis lhag chad bskang*/ bsdu ldang ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ ka las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la thim/ he ru ka bzhi po gtso bo la thim/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ (435)de yang je phra je phrar song nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang la thim/ 'od gsal las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ 'di'i bsnyen pa byed na yab kyi snying po 'bum phrag bzhi/ nye snying 'bum phrag bdun/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying 'bum phrag re re/ he ru ka bzhi la 'bum phrag re re/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi khri phrag re bzlas pas grub/ thun mtshams gtor 'bul sogs gsham nas 'byung ba ltar ro/

༈ /gnyis pa sta gon gyi rim pa la/ gnas khang rnying pa dang dkyil 'khor ras bris skabs sa chog mi dgos kyang*/ sa bcad tsam du dkar gtor bsham/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa mgron dgug /sngags de mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis phrin las bcol lo// sta gon dngos la gsum/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po lha sta gon ni/ bsang gtor dang dri bzang gi chus gtor ba'i gzhir slob dpon gyis gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying lan gsum gsum brjod de dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ he ru ka bzhi'i sngags brjod de phyogs bzhir zlum por byas par las rdor gyis me tog gi tshom bu re dgod/ de'i mdun du gtor ma dang*/ mtha' mchod pas bskor te/ bsang sbyang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs ma bkod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ lus dkyil gyi lha sum cu so bdun byang (436)chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ go cha dang*/ ye shes pa 'gugs pa/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ dam ye bsre ba rnams gyad sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mchod bstod kyang bsdu na de ltar dang*/ rgyas par spro na mdun bskyed skabs ltar byas te/

rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo he ru ka /phag mor lhan cig yang dag ldan// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas// nangs par dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bgyi// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par gyur/ uttiṣṭha/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btags pa nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam mo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ bum rdzas so lnga btab pa chas dang ldan pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis ka rtsa ba dang nag po med pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ kha g.yel ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ de'i nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ lcags kyu lnga/ sgron ma lnga rnams dang*/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus yongs su gang ba'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar padma nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyogs bzhir hūm̐ bzhi yongs su gyur pa las sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ rigs lnga'i de (437)bzhin gshegs ma bkod/ las bum gyi dbus su padma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du pam̐ las khaṇḍa ro hi nī dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/

bum mtshan rnams kyang rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sogs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bar sgrub thabs ltar la/ so sos dbu brgyan par gyur/ las bum gyi lha mo la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod kha gsos la mchod pa byin brlab/ mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ gzungs thag la brgyud nas bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa khengs par gyur/ ces bsams la rnam rgyal gyi lha la lha lnga'am/ spro na 'khor sngags rnams gsum re tsam dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar byas la yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dung zhal gyi chus/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum pa'i lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces bsam/ las thams cad pa'i lhas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces brjod de yig brgya bzla'o// gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob bu rnams 'dus la sgo drung du khrus bya/ kun slong bcos pa sogs chos bshad spyi ltar dang*/ 'dir ye shes mkha' 'gros grub chen tilli pa snyan brgyud du stsal ba'i nor bu skor gsum gyi gdams pa rnams dgyes mdzad mar pa lo tsās rje btsun mi la la chig brgyud du stsal/ des dka' (438)spyad chen pos nyams bzhes su mdzad pas sku tshe de nyid kyis mchog gi grub pa brnyes nas thugs sras zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa la snyan brgyud 'bring po/

nyi ma lta bu dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu la snyan brgyud rgyas pa/ ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza la snyan brgyud bsdus pa rnams stsal bzhin gsum ka'ang da lta'i bar du bka' lung gi zam ma chad cing byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma nyams par byon pa las/ 'dir ngan rdzong ston pa nas rje btsun gling ka ba sogs nas rim par brgyud pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bskur bsdus pa'i lugs bsgrub pa la slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang dbang bskur dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las 'dir slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bgyi ba yin pas zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams re 'bul mdzod/ ces mtshams sbyar la maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug / de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// de nas spro ba bskyed cing nyan par bskul ba ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po las// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// (439)thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces dang*/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs kyi// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// ces gsungs pa'i don ltar dga' spro khyad par can bskyed pa dang*/ nyan bar gdams pa'i don ltar rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis nyan par mdzad 'tshal/ de nas bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus pa'i drung du phyag 'tshal ba sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ khyad par byang sdom bzung nas srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*// rgyal sras tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang longs spyod mchod bgyis nas// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang rnams// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal nyan thos 'gro rnams kyis// bsgoms dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang*// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// (440)'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// de nas sngags sdom la thun mong ba brtul zhugs nyer lnga po 'dzin cing srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// thun mong brtul zhugs sdom pa ni// srog gcod rdzun du smra ba dang*// gzhan gyi bud med nor 'phrog dang*// chang 'thung myos par mi bgyi'o// rgyan po kha na ma tho'i zas// ngan tshig bstan bcos smra ba dang*// mu stegs kla klo'i chos spyod min// dud 'gro byis pa bud med dang*// skyes pa mchod rten bsnun mi bya// dag pa'i grogs dang rje bo dang*// dge 'dun rnams dang rgyal ba dang*// yid gtad rnams la 'khu mi bya// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la// mig sogs dbang po zhen mi bya// nga rgyal tshig rtsub spro thung dang*// phra ma sdig pa'i grogs rnams spang*// phyag rgya mtshan ma grib 'gom min// bya ba ma yin rnam par spang*// kha na ma tho'i las 'di dag

/deng nas brtsams te spang bar bgyi// de nas khyed rang slob ma rnams skad cig gis dpal he ru ka sngon po phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba'i skur gyur/ de la slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis dri'i thig le gnas gsum du byas pas dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes dri'i thig le bya/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ haḥdakar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po padma gar dbang*/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag (441)thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa haṃ ljang gu dpal rta mchog ste/ ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i go chas rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob ma bud med yod na/ lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar po sogs so sor dgod par gsung*/ de nas dngos grub kyi skal pa brtag pa la nyin mo dngos su brtag pa dang*/ mtshan mo rmi lam gyis brtag pa gnyis las/ dang po'i slad du so shing sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi phreng ba can slob ma'i dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas so shing dang so shing gi ra ba gnyis char byin gyis brlab/ khyed rang gi kha shar du phyogs pas so shing thal mo sbyar bas zungs la so shing gi ra bar sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad de 'dor bar mdzod/ oṃ badzra ha sa ha/ danta sho dha ni hūm̐/ zhes dor/ de yi tshe na mtshan ma ni// de tshe bdag la blta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du bstan gyur na// de yi dngos grub mchog ces bshad// de bzhin shar du bltas na ni// de yi dngos grub 'bring du 'gyur// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten gyi ni dngos grub 'thob// so shing dor ba 'ga' zhig las// gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi /dngos grub de la the tshom med// ces pa bzhin 'byung bas nges par mdzad 'tshal/ brgyud nas rmi lam gyi sgo nas brtag pa la rmi lam gsal ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ las bum gyi chu dung zhal du blugs pa/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzla/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa lan gsum blud pa lan gsum 'thung mdzod/ oṃ hrī bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni ṣatsā sya saṃ sho dhā ya sarba bi kalpā a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes blud/ de nas rmi lam gyi bar chad bsrung phyir srung skud gdags pa ni/ srung skud dmar po lus tshad sum lte ba la mdud pa gsum btab pa slob ma'i (442)sgo gsum dang rmi lam gyi bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa skyas pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas la btags te/ las sngags brjod cing las bum chu gtor/ mdud steng rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbā na swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha'i chun po che chung sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa slob ma'i rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ dhī hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ badzratīkṣ+ṇa hūm̐/ zhes pas sbyin/ ku sha'i sngas gdan la nyol la rmi lam rtogs shig /de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni 'di la gsan 'tshal/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dumbā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal ba bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu gcod// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// dbang thob rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang (443)ldan// lam 'dir khyod nyid 'gro gyur pas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/

ces gsungs pa'i tshig gi don ltar gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba la dga' ba dang spro ba rgya cher skyed mdzod// des sta gon gyi chos rnams grub pa lags/ zhes brjod de bsngo smon byas nas slob ma rnams kyis/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ stegs bu'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ dbus su mañdzi'i steng sngar sta gon byas pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa dung chos gzungs rdor bcas bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du las bum/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ mdun du thod chang*/ gsang thod dang rig tsaka /mtha' skor du chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yon skor/ rgyab phyogs su 'bul gtor lugs 'di'i phyag bzhes ltar grub dka' bas bshos zlum gtso 'khor lnga rgyan spros bcas pa bsham/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug /kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ru thod pa/ sgeg sogs brgyad rnams dngos sam tsakli gang bde/ mig thur/ me long*/ dril bu/ mda' gzhu/ pu sti 'khor lo dung*/ bde mchog gi sku tsaka /mig dang me tog /slob ma mchod pa nyer spyod lnga/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs 'du bya// de nas sgrub thabs kyi dag pa gsum dran pa nas brtsams te thun mtshams lhas ldang gi bar rdzogs par btang*/ bum bskyed bzlas pa sogs gong ltar tshang bar bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ nag po las 'od zer nag po hūm̐ gi rnam par 'phros pa 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs sgrub thabs ltar mngon rtogs tshang bar brjod/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sogs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sta gon gyi lha la'ang dmigs te spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ/ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang 'byon pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin (444)du gar dmigs der snang ba// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka

/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis dad pas deng 'dir spyan 'dren na// dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon mdzod// badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ de dag gnyis su med par gyur/ bar brjod/ mchod pa byin brlab/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ oṃ/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ/ dag cing dri med= sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu= bzhes nas= pā dyaṃ= me tog 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ badzra puṣpe= nags tshal las byung phan pa yi// dag pa'i dri ldang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis= bzhes nas= dhū pe= srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gis= bzhes nas= ā lo ke= lhan cig skyes dang sbyor ba'i dri// tshim byed dag pa'i dri mchog 'di// bdag gis= bzhes nas= gandhe= bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i// kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bdag gis= bzhes nas= nai wi dya= phaṭa ha dang cang te'u dang*// sgra dbyangs yid 'phrog sna tshogs pa// bdag gis= bzhes nas= shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ khyad par rig ma bcu drug 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra wī ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mṛ daṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mu ra dze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra hā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra lā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gī rti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra nṛ tye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ (445)badzra dhū pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dī pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gandhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ra sa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sparshe badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar bya/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor la/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ shrī buddha he he= karma= padma= ratna= yum bzhi ni/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lā me= khaṇḍa ro hi= rū pi ni= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mtheb srin gyis 'thor la 'bul/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rang gis myong*/ gsang mchod ni/ lta dang rgod dang lag 'dzin dang*// 'khyud dang gnyis sprod sogs mchod pas// dbang bskur bar ni 'gyur ba dang*// rgyud rnams kun gyi don rtogs shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms pas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// yab yum gyi bstod pa rkang brgyad ni/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// dbu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra st+wa zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung rtse bsnams// rab 'jigs (446)stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud ka bgegs 'dul mdzad la 'dud/

oṃ/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs kun rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs kun skem zhing pham mdzad ma// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces bstod/ sgrub thabs ltar bzlas dmigs dang bsnyen dzab rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma 'jug pa ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs par blangs pa'i mthar bden stobs brjod pa ni/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor 'dir// bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin gnyis med las byung ba// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / de nas gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin brlab// sngags rnams kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las bcol lo/ ༈ bzhi pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ sgo drung du khrus byas/ phyag 'tshal gral du 'khod pa la sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad ci rigs dang khyad par/ 'dir dgyes mdzad mar pa lo tsā'i thugs bcud bde mchog snyan brgyud bsdus pa ngan rdzong ston pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur bgyi ba la slob dpon gyis bgyis 'os mtha' dag legs (447)par grub/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'o skal du gyur pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor dang*/

zhugs pa la mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i ched du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /'di man gyi mtshams spyod rnams spyi ltar byas la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum/ oṃ tsakṣū rbhandha wa ra mā ṇa ya hūm̐ gi sa mig dar dang*/ oṃ a khaṃ gī ra hūm̐ gi sa me tog sbyin/ rigs dang 'dun pa nges pa'i phyir/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o// de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po sogs brjod/ skyabs su 'gro zhing so thar gyi sdom pa bzung ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// snying po byang chub mchis kyi bar// bla ma la sogs spyan snga ru// mya ngan 'da' ba'i bsam pa yis// gnod pa gzhir bcas las ldog cing*// spong ba bcu dang bcas pa yi// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la// yang dag nyid du gnas bgyid do// lan gsum/ bshags sdom sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzung ba ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag (448gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi srung ngo// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgal bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/

ces lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar bden gnyis kyi ngo bo zla dkyil dang*/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ gsum/ de brtan phyir rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs kyi/ gzhan ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o// slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos (449)khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs dam bzhag rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs gyur te// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na khyod mgo bo 'gem par byed do// gnyis ka'i dam bzhag mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ sa chu byin gyis brlab/ 'di ni khyod kyi bdud rtsi ste// ma bsrungs sreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrungs na dngos grub 'byung ba ste// bdud rtsi lnga yi chus 'grub bo// oṃ badzra u da ka ṭha ṭha/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

ye shes dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di la/ he ru ka'i byin rlabs kyi ngo bo// sdig pa'i drwa ba 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ mi shigs pa'i yon tan gyi rang bzhin/ rnam pa thams cad gsal ba'i me long*/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ khyed rnams he ru ka sngon po rdo dril 'dzin cing g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pas bzhugs pa'i thugs kar chos 'byung sngon po'i dbus su yi ge bdun pa kha dog sna tshogs pa kyi li li 'khor bar gyur/ bla ma'i thugs ka dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas he ru ka grangs med pa byon nas snying gar thim par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru shri dzñā na ā we sha ya a aḥ yab yum kyi snying po'i mthar/ (450)tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya hūm̐/ shrī he ru ka bidma he bidyā rā dza ya dhī ma he swā hā/ lan mang du brjod la dang ba/ bstan pa'i phyir rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ sa me tog 'bul/ pra ti gṛhṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la/ zhes me tog dbang rtags su byin/ mig dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra nai tra a ba ha ra pa tra laṃ hrī prām̐/ zhes mig ras dbye/ de nas/ he badzra pā shya/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma'i rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon sum gyur// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ zhes dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs bzhugs pa yin te/

de'ang chos 'byung gi dbus su padma rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang*/ phyogs bzhir/ shrī he ru ka khrag 'thung dpal/ sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs ma bkod/ gtso bo yab kyi sku'i gnas rnams dang thugs kar yang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs drug cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa/ de rnams brten pa lha ste dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pas dad gus dga' spro rgya cher skyed mdzod/ des 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ bum gsang sher yi tshig dbang ngo*// dang po bum dbang la lnga/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang*/ lung bstan/ rjes gnang*/ khyad par (451 )lus dkyil gyi dbang rnams so// dang po ni/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la bum dbang rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal phul/ gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba bskyab phyir gzi brjid che// ji ltar yon tan cher 'byung ba// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ lan gsum/ bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'khod par mos la 'di'i= sgrub thabs ltar sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug / me tog phul la rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum/ de nas nang dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis khyed rnams drangs te zhal du zhugs pa bde bas zhu ba yum gyi padmar babs pa mi bskyod pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi skur gyur/

de nyid phyir thon te 'khod pa la bum pa mi bskyod pa zhu ba'i chur gyur/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar he ru ka rdor dril 'dzin pas yum phag mo la 'khyud pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems babs pa dang mnyam du 'od zer 'phros pas/ rigs ldan ma mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig mas glu len/ byang sems kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bar chad sel/ lha mos mchod pa dang bcas te/ dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi mthing ga slob ma'i snying gar zhugs te/ lus sngo mer gyis gang bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni khyod la dbang bskur (452)mchog gi bkra shis shog / rnam bum spyi bor bzhag la/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// zhe sdang rnam dag mi bskyod pa// dpal ldan chu yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'dus pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ cod pan gyi dbang gi slad du khyed rnams dang cod pan rin 'byung 'khor lo bde mchog gi rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ bla ma he ru ka'i lte bar ratna he ru ka ser po rin dril 'dzin pas gzugs can ma la 'khyud pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas sogs gong ltar la/ bdud rtsi ser po slob ma'i lte bar zhugs te lus ser mer gyis gang bar gyur/ dbu rgyan thogs la/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis// nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// rdo rje'i cod pan dbang bskur ro// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta ratna he ru ka / dbu rgyan bcing*/ rnam bum chu 'thor la/

oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'dus pa las rin 'byung gis dbur brgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du khyed rnams dang rdo rje 'od dpag med 'khor lo bde mchog gi rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ bla ma he ru ka'i mgrin par padma he ru ka dmar po pad dril 'dzin pas du ma skyes ma la 'khyud pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sogs gong ltar la/ bdud rtsi dmar po slob ma'i mgrin par zhugs te lus dmar mer gyis gang bar gyur/ rdo rje thogs la/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa// so sor kun rtog ye shes can// 'dod chags dag pa snang mtha' yi// rdo rje padmas= oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje lag g.yas su sbyin/ chu dbang gong ltar/ zhes dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'dus pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dril bu'i dbang gi slad (453)du khyed rnams dang dril bu don grub 'khor lo bde mchog gi rang bzhin du gyur/ bla ma he ru ka'i gsang gnas su karma he ru ka ljang gu rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pas lā ma la 'khyud pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i yo gas gong ltar la/ bdud rtsi ljang gu slog ma'i gsang bar zhugs te lus ljang mer gyis gang bar gyur/ dril bu thogs la/ 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa// bya ba nan tan ye shes can// phrag dog dag pa don grub kyi// dril bu chen pos= oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta karma he ru ka a= oṃ badzra a bhi pa ti st+waṃ/ zhes dril bu lag g.yon du sbyin chu dbang gong ltar/ zhes dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'dus pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ ming dbang gi slad du khyed rnams rnam snang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ bla ma he ru ka'i spyi bor buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor dril 'dzin pas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/

snyoms par zhugs pa'i sogs gong ltar/ bdud rtsi dkar po slob ma'i spyi bor zhugs te lus dkar mer gyis gang bar gyur/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can// gti mug dag pa rnam snang gi// dpal ldan ming gis dbang bskur ro// rdor dril bsnol mar spyi bor 'khrol la/ oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta buddha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ so so'i gsang mtshan nam spyi tsam du/ kye dpal mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// chu dbang gong ltar/ zhes dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'dus pa las rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ de ltar dbang lnga thob pas/ nyon mongs lnga spangs/ ye shes lnga dang ldan/ rig ma yum dang 'brel bas rig pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung (454)gnas stsal// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par mdzod/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i lus dkyil gyi shar sgor dbang stegs seng khrir khyed rnams rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis rdo rje sems dpa' spyan drangs te thim par mos/ rdor dril bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje a las dril bu rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' kun gyi bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje lag g.yas su bzhag la gsor du gzhug / aḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag

/ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// badzra ghāṇḍe aḥ zhes dril bu lag g.yon du bzhag la dkrol du gzhag / phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du rdor dril lhan cig gtad de/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo nyid// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rang gi sku yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// oṃ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ rdor dril 'khyud rgyas gzung du gzhug / rig pa thams cad bde stong ye shes su shar ba thugs kyi dam tshig /sgra thams cad skye ba med pa gsung gi dam tshig /snang ba thams cad lha sku phyag rgya chen por shes pa sku'i dam tshig go /slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga spyan drangs pas bum chus dbang bskur bar mos shig /phung po lnga po rnam dgag ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyis// dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga yi// rdo rje chu yi= dbang gi sngags lnga po brjod/ chus lus gang*/ dri ma dag /mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur te/ dbang gi (455)lhas me tog gi char phab/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags ta khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bar gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i mos pas/ dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan pa la// dus gsum du ni bde bar rol/ zhes gdams/ bla ma'i bka' mi bcag pa dang*// gsang ba 'di gzhan la mi bshad pa dang*// dam tshig thams cad bsrung bar bya'o// zhes gdams pa la/ slob mas kyang*/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sems can rnams// ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur zhing*// de lta de ltar chags la sogs// dri med sems can don bya'o// lung bstan pa ni/ bla ma'i phyag g.yas spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di yis dbang bskur gyur pa ni// bsngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi bdag

/bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan to// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir dbang bskur ba ni// dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur ba yin cing*/ gang dag rdo rje slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa de la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mos shig / de nas rjes gnang rnams las brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang ni slob ma dang rgyan drug bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ 'khor lo hūm̐ las badzra he ru ka yab yum/ rna cha hrīḥlas padma= mgul rgyan trām̐ las ratna= gdu bu oṃ las buddha= ske rags āḥlas karma= thal chen hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yab yum/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga rdor sems dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ rang rigs kyis dbur brgyan/ zhu ba las rgyan drug tu gyur pa khyed rnams la byin par mos shig /'khor lo'i tshul gyis mi bskyod pa// rna (456)cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen 'byung*// lag gdub rnam par snang mdzad de// ske rags la ni don yod grub// yan lag kun la rdo rje 'dzin/ zhes sbyin/ kha ṭwāṃ ga

/ḍa ma ru/ ka pā la he ru ka yab yum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa byin te/ kha ṭwāṃ gzugs la shes rab ste// thabs kyi gzugs ni cang te'u nyid// ka pā la ni ātt+ras bkang*// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// dpa' bo chen pos gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ āḥsgeg mo// oṃ phreng ba ma/ gī glu ma/ hoḥgar ma/ āḥbadug spos ma/ bhrūm̐ me tog ma/ pra mar me ma/ gi dri chab ma ste mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ mig thur gyis rab rib bsal bar mos/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥprāṃ/ chos thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig / me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// chos thams cad dril bu'i sgra ltar shes par gyis shig / dril bu dkrol la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// mda' gzhu gtad pa phyogs drug tu 'phangs tshul byas te 'di nyid rjes zlos byar gzhug / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o// rang sems me long nang gi rdo rje ltar rdo rje sems dpar shes par gyis shig / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me long bstan la/ rdo rje sems (457)dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/

chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ pu sti 'khor lo dung rnams byin la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad// rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas so so'i phyag rgya 'ching mdzod// sems can kun la thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rdo rje'i 'khor lo= rin chen 'khor lo= padma'i 'khor lo= sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor// slob ma lha la 'bul ba ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'dzin gyur pa'i// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ dbugs dbyung ba ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis// de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// gzengs bstod pa ni/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// nan tan du gdams pa ni/ rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung*// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// de nas thun mong ma yin pa lus dkyil gyi dbang ni/ khyed rang rnams 'khor lo bde mchog tu (458)gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi thod pa bum pa dang bcas pa/

lus kyi gnas nyer bzhir dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ yan lag bzhi dang mig gnyis rna ba gnyis rnams su sgo mtshams ma brgyad de lus dkyil 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs drug cu rtsa gnyis gsal bar gyur/ bla ma'i sku'i 'khor lo lnga las re re chad de khyed rnams kyi lha rnams la thim par gyur/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs de dag las 'od zer sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par 'phros te/ snod kyi 'jig rten dag pa lha'i gzhal yas khang du byas/ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo'i dam par byas nas thams cad kyang he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod cing*/ de dag kyang 'od dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin du byas nas rang la thim/ rang yang 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor lo lnga po'ang rim gyis bde mchog yab yum la thim/ bde mchog kyang rim gyis 'dus nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yang nam mkha'i dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med du 'od gsal du zhugs par gyur/ de'i ngang las zung 'jug gi skur ldangs te/ de'ang he ru ka lha lnga lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs thams cad zung 'jug gi sku sgyu ma lta bur gyur/ sku rdo rje me long du ngo sprad pa ni/ bde mchog gi sku gzugs me long la 'char du bcug la bstan te/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ sogs gong bzhin brjod/ gsung rdo rje brjod med du ngo sprad pa ni/ dril bu dkrol te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de sogs gong ltar brjod/ thugs rdo rje rtog med du ngo sprad pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa bstan te/ hūm̐/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin nyid// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// skye med chos kyi rdo rje 'di// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// de nas rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las bla ma'i sku lus (459)la brten nas bum pa'i dbang thob/

lam bskyed pa'i rim pa nang lus dkyil bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// mgon pos rjes su bzung bar mdzod/ lan gsum/ mig dar bcing*/ bla ma he ru ka yum bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang*/ 'od kyis dpa' bo dpa' mo spyan drangs/ thugs kar zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de sbyor mtshams nas babs pa khyed rnams la byin par mos/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// sngon chad sras ni dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin du ni byang chub sems// bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes bdud rtsi sbyin/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod pas myong*/ lus kun dang a wa dhū ti gang bar gyur pas gsal stong rang byung gi ye shes bskyed par mos/ mig dar 'gro la/ de ltar gsang dbang thob pas rig stong gi nyams skyes/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ gsol 'dabs rjes zlos/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba bzhin// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ gsum/ mig dar 'ching*/ khyed rnams he ru ka zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su bsgoms pa'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur/ yum las sprul pa'i rig ma mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkha' āḥlas padmar gyur pa nyid byin te/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// lha mo (460)des kyang*/ e ma nga yi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// padmar bya ba ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po 'ga' zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med/

st+waṃ padma mokṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing pang du byon pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas dpa' bo thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs pas lus la bde ba dang*// sems 'od gsal bar byas/ de'i gtum mo'i mes khams zhu nas lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi bskyed par mos/ mig dar 'grol/ sher dbang thob pas bde stong lhan skyes kyi nyams skyes/ sems kyi dri ma dag 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// dbang bzhi ba tshig dbang rin po che ni/ gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ skyabs med skyob pa skyabs kyi mchog /dpal ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che// mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig / lan gsum/ ngo sprod pa ni/ 'di ni rang rig mdzes ma ste// phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o// rig 'di bor nas de las ni// gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med// rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu// brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla ma'i bla// ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// bltas pas sems la grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// rang sems chos sku'i me long la// gnyis med ye shes 'od du shar// shar tsam nyid nas grub pa med// bde chen lhan cig skyes pa yin// dbang gsum pa'i dus su thabs gyi rlung dang rtog pa mngon gyur rtsol bas bkag nas rang gi sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ don gyi rig ma 'di bor na spros pa (461)gzhan gyis sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog rig ma 'di dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig /de ltar dbang bzhi pa zung 'jug gi nyams skyes/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags dag /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so// des dbang bskur rnams grub nas/ dam tshig khas blang ba/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar byas pas grub bo/ lnga pa rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa la/ dang po lag mchod ni/ lag g.yon bsang sbyang*/ lag mthil du bdud rtsi'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu tshig bstun dgod cing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du padma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ pam̐/ mdun nas g.yon skor du/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa rnams las yum gyi go cha'i lha mo rnams dang*/ mthe bong sogs lnga dang*/ sen mo'i ngos la oṃ taḥ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa phaṭa haṃ rnams las yab kyi go cha'i lha rnams me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur khams lnga rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor gyur/ gong gi sngags rnams lan gcig brjod pa'i mthar/ puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi 'thor/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes lag mthil spyi bor byugs la/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes mos/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ nar mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gu ru maṇḍa la de ba ḍā ki nī dharma pā la badzra yo ga yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol/ 'jig rten pa la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas btang ngo// de nas tshogs mchod ni/ thabs shes kyi rdzas sogs bza' btung ji ltar 'os par bsham/ bdud rtsi ltar byin brlab/ tshogs kyi yo byad zad mi shes pa'i (462)'dod yon rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba/ bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang tha mi dad pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/

yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa tshogs 'gron rnams spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa bstim/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// dug gsum dbang gis sdig pa bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// khams gsum 'gro ba'i don bzhugs gsol// dge bas sku gsum myur thob shog / ces yan lag bdun pa phul/ spro na rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'i rjes tshogs phud cha gnyis su bsdus te/ phud dang po dkyil 'khor gyi mdun nam gtor ma la bran/ byin rlabs sngar bzhin dang*/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa shrī tsakra samba ra wī ra yo gi nī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis tshogs gtor 'bul zhing*/ spros pa la dga' na zhu dbul sogs sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ gang ltar yang rang he ru ka lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bzhin pas dam tshig gi rdzas la zhen pa med par longs spyad/ phud cha gnyis dang*/ lhag ma bsdus te slob dpon gyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas la dā nas la phu btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ sa brlab/ oṃ dzña na ma ya lo ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra dzñā na sa ma ya karma ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs nas/ gṛhṇa daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa sī swā hā/ zhes sngags tshang ba lan res bsngos la/ lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs// ye (463)shes dam tshig 'jig rten gyi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//

sogs kyis phrin las bcol lo// mchod pa kha gsos la 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba ni/ dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yis// bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi spyi bor thim/ sku las sku dpag tu med pa byung lus la thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ zhal nas sngags phreng dpag tu med pa byung ngag la thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros rang gi snying gar thim/ thugs ka nas phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ de nas bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur/ sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib dag /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob// lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom (464)pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan tu

bsams la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /bzod par gsol ba ni/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya sogs/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis bgyis nongs ci mchis pa// de yang mgon pos bzod par gsol// dkyil 'khor ras bris skabs/ ye shes pa rnams rten 'di nyid la 'byung ba bzhis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis nye bar mtshon te bdag dang 'khor 'das sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las zhing khams gdul bya sku tshe mdzad pa sogs da lta nyid du mnyam par gyur nas chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthar thug gi sems can thams cad 'khor ba dong nas ma sprugs kyi bar du 'bad rtsol dang thogs thug med par grol ba'i don rgyun chad med pa 'byung bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas sku bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sogs shlo ka brjod/ shis brjod ni zhal nas gsungs pas thog drangs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// ngam rdzong ras pa la slob ma gling ka ba sogs grub thob thor bu re byon pa las/ chos brgyud cher ma 'phel stabs snyan brgyud skor yang rgyun ma chad tsam las bka' brgyud spyi la mi snang bas rgyun la bsams nas 'bad pas btsal te smin grol phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o// lhag bsam 'od dkar snang bas bzhad pa yi//

(465) zab gsang kunda'i dga' tshal gsar du rgyas// smin grol bcud kyis thar pa'i lang tshor rtas// bde chen rdo rje'i sku mchog myur 'grub shog /tshul 'di nyid grub dbang bde chen rdo rjes rtsa tho zin bris tsam mdzad pa la kha skong dgos pa rnams rigs mthun gyi gzhung las blangs te karma bka' brgyud kyi gral mthar 'khod pa'i dge sbyong ltar snang ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos rang lo gya bdun par dpal spungs yang khrod de bī ko ṭā'i sgrub gnas su spel ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /maṅga laṃ/// / (466)
